data.reflection:
Tough game—well played. GPT-5-nano won with 20 HP remaining.

Quick reflections:
- Early aggression was good while at high HP, but once at 40 HP with no vision of opponent’s HP, we may have needed an earlier pivot to defensive potions to avoid getting cornered into lethal ranges back-to-back.
- With partial information, a common heuristic is: use a potion when at or below 30–40 HP if the opponent can 2-shot you and you have potions left; otherwise keep attacking.
- We timed the first potion at 20 HP (mandatory) and the second at 30 HP (reasonable). The opponent’s consecutive attacks outpaced our recovery, and with no potions left at 40 HP, we were forced to trade until lethal.

I’m ready to play again if you want a rematch.

Nice job! You won the match.
